limitations: static imports only; dynamic LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress and all future Job descendants unverified
desktop static model uses containing directory and system targets only; actual initial OS loader search remains unverified
API-set host and forwarder resolution must use this target and importing module; no fixed KernelBase guess
file/symbol availability is not source trust, minimum-toolset acceptance or a native capability

os.installation_type: Client or server; desktop scope is Client

target_fields.system_directory: actual GetSystemDirectoryW result, never PATH or guessed C drive
target_fields.system_files: exact requested basenames: path/size/SHA256/PE Machine/FileVersion/Authenticode status; missing or unknown explicit
target_fields.api_set: ApiSetSchema file identity/hash/version plus target contract-to-host mapping for each importer; presence/hash alone is not resolution
target_fields.module_exports: exact named/ordinal exports and forwarder strings of requested target hosts, read from the same hashed image
target_fields.toolchains: use the attached pinned-asset/header/compiler-string facts now; linker fields alone do not prove a minimum CRT toolset. Lock published upstream minima where available; do not invent missing producer metadata or substitute it for target compatibility tests
target_fields.loaded_origins: later original process HANDLE/birth/Job/image and module source observations; not collected by this static plan
